column1: # The face evaluation set behind the face-model comparison (docs/faces.md): 130 photos, 4 to 8 of each of 22 public figures (the person column
# is an anonymous label), from Wikimedia Commons, every file marked Public domain or CC0 on its Commons page (mostly works of the US federal
# government and photographs old enough to be out of copyright). The originals are pinned by sha256 (they are the uploaded files, not thumbnails).
# Fetched by scripts/fetch-face-eval-set.sh, which looks each pageid up on the Commons API for the file's URL. How it was chosen, and cleaned by eye, is in docs/faces.md.
